TripPlan.rule: active roots require explicit target policy, disclosure, timezone, capacity, room and host-authority bindings; archived roots remain archived

TripPlanRevision.rule: immutable source revisions retain source identity and order; no mutable current-plan fallback

TripMembership.rule: participation and organizer authority remain separate; organizer authority requires explicit evidence

TripMoment.rule: only canonical content references recirculate; inline content is never copied

TripPlanContentLink.rule: content remains owned by Content and is linked only by canonical reference

TripGuideAssignment.rule: cancelled assignments are archived; active assignments are not_applicable while no canonical target guide-assignment contract exists, and never manufacture Host authority

TripPlanPlacement.rule: conversation and Circle placements become typed source or room references only when the target binding is explicit

TripMapView.rule: derived projections are rebuilt from target facts and are never imported as authoritative state

TripTimelineView.rule: derived projections are parity inputs only and are never written directly

TripShareSnapshot.rule: immutable snapshots remain audit inputs; target Board and Content projections rebuild from canonical references

TripPlanTemplate.rule: archived templates remain archived; active templates are explicitly not_applicable until a canonical target template contract exists
